rules.statement: A conveyance of property held in trust for a company to be formed can be chargeable with duty under Item 23 (4) of the Stamps Ordinance, even if the company is not yet in existence at the time of the initial transfer.
rules.supporting_quote: "Property can be held by a person in trust to convey it to a Company which is to-come into existence in the future. When immovable property thus held in trust is conveyed by the trustee to the Company when formed, the deed of transfer is a conveyance 'by a trustee without consideration to the person beneficially entitled ', and as such attracts only the duty chargeable under Item 23 (4) of; Part 1 of the Schedule to the Stamps Ordinance."
